facts.fact: At the third ordinary meeting of the Conselho Consultivo da Economia Digital on 25 November 2025, chaired by the Vice-Prime Minister, the Estratégia da Economia Digital de Cabo Verde, which the document says guides the country's transformation into a platform country, was presented to the council; the document does not say it was adopted.
facts.system: Estratégia para a Economia Digital de Cabo Verde

systems.owner: Government of Cabo Verde; initial financing from the African Development Bank
Vice-Prime Minister and Minister of Digital Economy
